reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR on the front, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP, and a brand with zero reviews doesn't get $30 from me. Also two capsules a day and no size listed, and I've already left bad reviews on big capsules.
objection: No reviews, no NSF or USP seal, and I can't tell how big the capsules are. I have tried three magnesium brands this year and I'm not paying $1 a day to be the guinea pig for a fourth.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews saying the capsules are small and easy to swallow, plus an NSF or USP mark, at a lower price per serving.
